items.title: PSA: Usage Rate only attributes a percent of possessions that ends with said player, it’s not indicative of how much they control the ball
items.author: GarriganGate
items.body_excerpt: I still see people constantly misusing the usage rate stat. Especially a big conversation I see regarding Philly’s roster. Usage rate calculates how much of a team possession ends with that specific player. Possessions can only END with a shot, free throw attempt, or turnover.…
